title: A bill to authorize the use of off-highway vehicles in certain areas of the Capitol Reef National Park, Utah.
short_title: To authorize the use of off-highway vehicles in certain areas of the Capitol Reef…

summary: This bill makes the state law of Utah applicable to the use of motor vehicles (including off-highway vehicles) on the portions of each of Burr Trail Road, Cathedral Road, Hartnet Road, Highway 24, Notom Bullfrog Road, Polk Creek Road, Oil Well Bench Road, Baker Ranch Road, South Desert Overlook Road, Temple of the Sun and Moon Road, Gypsum Sinkhole Road, and Sulphur Creek Road that are located within the boundaries of the Capitol Reef National Park in Utah.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
